headline: Approved three memorandums of agreement accepting and spending funds for youth summer programs (CYEP, DADS, DCF).
summary: No public input was given. No new or unfinished business was discussed. Each of the three funding items passed, with one abstention from Hunt.
decisions: Approved acceptance and spending of CYEP youth summer program funds for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, 6-0 with 1 abstention.
Approved acceptance and spending of DADS youth summer program funds for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, 5-0 with 1 abstention.
Approved acceptance and spending of DCF youth summer program funds for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, 5-0 with 1 abstention.

decision_evidence.quote: ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE AND EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS JULY 1, 2026- JUNE 30, 2027, CT YOUTH EMPLOYMENT PROGRAM (CYEP) YOUTH SERVICES SUMMER PROGRAM ... Vote: 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Hunt). The item passed unanimously.

ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE AND EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS JULY 1, 2026- JUNE 30, 2027, DADS YOUTH SUMMER PROGRAM (DADS) ... Vote: 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Hunt). Majority Leader Gallagher was not present for the vote. The item passed unanimously.

ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE AND EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS JULY 1, 2026- JUNE 30, 2027, DCF YOUTH SUMMER PROGRAM ... Vote: 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Hunt). The item passed unanimously.

1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Human Services Committee Meeting, September 14, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting was 
called to order at 8:39pm with the members noted above in attendance.  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to provide public input.  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming Boards and Commission meetings was shared.  There were no 
other Board, Commission or Department updates for this evening’s meeting.  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZING 
THE ACCEPTANCE AND EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS JULY 1, 2026- JUNE 30, 
2027, CT YOUTH EMPLOYMENT PROGRAM (CYEP) YOUTH SERVICES 
SUMMER PROGRAM 
Motion to open item 4.1 was made by Majority Leader Gallagher and seconded by 
Council member Foley. 
Director Bivens provided an overview. 
Vote: 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Hunt). The item passed unanimously. 
  
  2. ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZING 
THE ACCEPTANCE AND EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS JULY 1, 2026- JUNE 30, 
2027, DADS YOUTH SUMMER PROGRAM (DADS) 
Motion to open item 4.2 was made by Council member Foley and seconded by Pro 
Tem Cardwell. 
Director Bivens provided an overview of the item. 
Vote: 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Hunt).  Majority Leader Gallagher was not 
present for the vote.  The item passed unanimously.
3. ORDER APPROVING A MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZING 
THE ACCEPTANCE AND EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS JULY 1, 2026- JUNE 30, 
2027, DCF YOUTH SUMMER PROGRAM 
Motion to open item 4.3 was made by Council member Foley and seconded by Pro 
Tem Cardwell. 
Director Bivens provided an overview. 
Vote: 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention (Hunt).  The item passed unanimously.  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting.  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting.  
7. ADJOURN at 8:48pm 
With no additional business before the Committee, Chair Crouch adjourned at 8:48pm.
